```{r packages}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

red <- "#B22222"
green <- "#1D6F42"

# reliability of the score
rel <- 0.7

# annotation text size
txt <- 12 / .pt

theme_set(theme_pubr(base_size = 14) + theme(legend.title = element_blank()))
```

## Figure 1

```{r figure1, fig.width=11.5, fig.height=5.625}
cutoff <- qnorm(0.2)

dens <- tibble(x = seq(-3.5, 3.5, length.out = 601)) %>%
  mutate(y = dnorm(x))

# draws a little stick child at x0
stick_child <- function(x0, colour, y0 = 0.006, h = 0.045, stretch = 16) {
  w <- h * stretch

  head <- tibble(t = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 60)) %>%
    mutate(x = x0 + 0.2 * w * cos(t),
           y = y0 + h * (0.78 + 0.2 * sin(t)))

  limbs <- tibble(x = 0,
                  y = c(0.58, 0.5, 0.5, 0.26, 0.26),
                  xend = c(0, -0.24, 0.24, -0.15, 0.15),
                  yend = c(0.26, 0.32, 0.32, 0, 0)) %>%
    mutate(x = x0 + w * x,
           xend = x0 + w * xend,
           y = y0 + h * y,
           yend = y0 + h * yend)

  list(
    geom_segment(data = limbs, aes(x, y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
                 colour = colour, linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "round",
                 inherit.aes = FALSE),
    geom_polygon(data = head, aes(x, y), fill = "white", colour = colour,
                 linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )
}

p1 <- dens %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  geom_area(data = filter(dens, x <= cutoff), fill = red, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_area(data = filter(dens, x >= cutoff), fill = green, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dashed") +
  stick_child(cutoff - 0.25, red) +
  stick_child(cutoff + 0.25, green) +
  annotate("segment", x = -2.15, y = 0.275, xend = cutoff - 0.3, yend = 0.065,
           colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = -2.15, y = 0.285, label = "Near-identical children,\nopposite labels",
           size = txt, vjust = 0, colour = "grey30", lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("text", x = cutoff - 0.1, y = 0.41, label = "Threshold c",
           hjust = 1, size = txt) +
  annotate("text", x = -2.4, y = 0.1, label = "Coal", colour = red,
           fontface = "bold", size = txt) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.4, y = 0.1, label = "Gift", colour = green,
           fontface = "bold", size = txt) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3.5, 3.5), ylim = c(0, 0.43), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Observed conduct score, X", y = "Density")

# correlation kept at each split
retained <- function(p) dnorm(qnorm(p)) / sqrt(p * (1 - p))

p2 <- tibble(p = seq(0.02, 0.98, length.out = 601)) %>%
  mutate(kept = retained(p)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(p, kept)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("point", x = 0.5, y = sqrt(2 / pi), colour = green, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.53, y = 0.87, label = "Median split\n≈ 0.80",
           colour = green, hjust = 0, size = txt, lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("point", x = 0.1, y = retained(0.1), colour = red, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.13, y = 0.52, label = "Tail split\n(high-risk cut)",
           colour = red, hjust = 0, size = txt, lineheight = 0.95) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 0.92), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Proportion classified 'naughty', q",
       y = expression("Correlation retained, " * italic(r)[pb] / rho))

p1 + p2
```

## Figure 2

```{r simulate}
set.seed(1225)

# christmas day 2026
n_sim <- 251226

v_eps <- 1 - rel
v_u <- 0.15

noise <- function(v) rnorm(n_sim, 0, sqrt(v))

kids <- tibble(theta = noise(rel)) %>%
  mutate(
    truth = theta < quantile(theta, 0.2),

    # both read the same logbook
    logbook = theta + noise(v_eps),
    santa_same = logbook + noise(v_u),
    elf_same = logbook + noise(v_u),

    # each makes fresh observations
    santa_fresh = theta + noise(v_eps) + noise(v_u),
    elf_fresh = theta + noise(v_eps) + noise(v_u),

    # two logbooks, each read by both
    logbook_a = theta + noise(v_eps),
    logbook_b = theta + noise(v_eps),
    list_a = (logbook_a + noise(v_u)) + (logbook_a + noise(v_u)),
    list_b = (logbook_b + noise(v_u)) + (logbook_b + noise(v_u))
  )

# worst fifth goes on the list
naughty <- function(score) score < quantile(score, 0.2)
```

```{r results}
labels <- c(one = "One list",
            same = "Two assessors,\nsame logbook",
            fresh = "Two assessors,\nfresh observations",
            two = "Two logbooks,\neach checked twice")

agreement <- kids %>%
  summarise(same = sum(naughty(santa_same) == naughty(elf_same)),
            fresh = sum(naughty(santa_fresh) == naughty(elf_fresh)),
            two = sum(naughty(list_a) == naughty(list_b))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "scenario", values_to = "agree") %>%
  mutate(total = n_sim,
         value = agree / total,
         label = factor(labels[scenario], levels = rev(labels)))

# scores are added together before cutting
accuracy <- kids %>%
  transmute(truth,
            one = santa_same,
            same = santa_same + elf_same,
            fresh = santa_fresh + elf_fresh,
            two = list_a + list_b) %>%
  pivot_longer(one:two, names_to = "scenario", values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(scenario) %>%
  filter(naughty(score)) %>%
  summarise(correct = sum(truth),
            on_list = n(),
            value = mean(truth)) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(labels[scenario], levels = rev(labels)))

agreement %>% select(scenario, agree, total, value)
accuracy %>% select(scenario, correct, on_list, value)
```

```{r figure2, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.625}
bars <- function(data, title) {
  data %>%
    ggplot(aes(value, label, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.62) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * value)), hjust = -0.15, size = txt) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(one = "grey45", same = red, fresh = green, two = green),
                      guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(100 * x, "%"),
                       limits = c(0, 1.08), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "plain"),
          plot.title.position = "plot")
}

bars(agreement, "How often the two lists agree") +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = "One list", label = "No second list",
           hjust = 0, size = txt, colour = "grey45") +
  bars(accuracy, "Children on the list who are truly naughty") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
```

## Figure 3

```{r simulate3}
set.seed(45)

threshold <- -1

children <- tibble(theta = rnorm(400, 0, sqrt(rel))) %>%
  mutate(year1 = theta + rnorm(n(), 0, sqrt(1 - rel)),
         year2 = theta + rnorm(n(), 0, sqrt(1 - rel)),
         group = case_when(year1 >= threshold ~ "All other children",
                           year2 < threshold ~ "Naughty in both years",
                           TRUE ~ "Naughty in year 1, nice in year 2"))

children %>% count(group)
```

```{r figure3, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
lines <- tibble(slope = c(1, rel),
                intercept = 0,
                what = c("Line of equality", "Regression line (slope R = 0.7)"))

children %>%
  ggplot(aes(year1, year2)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = threshold, colour = red, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, colour = red, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(data = lines, aes(slope = slope, intercept = intercept,
                                colour = what, linewidth = what)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = group, shape = group), size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 3.25, y = threshold - 0.1, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
           label = "Threshold, year 2", colour = red, size = txt) +
  annotate("text", x = threshold + 0.1, y = -3.15, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
           label = "Threshold, year 1", colour = red, size = txt) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    breaks = c("All other children", "Naughty in both years",
               "Naughty in year 1, nice in year 2", "Line of equality",
               "Regression line (slope R = 0.7)"),
    values = c("All other children" = "grey72",
               "Naughty in both years" = red,
               "Naughty in year 1, nice in year 2" = green,
               "Line of equality" = "grey55",
               "Regression line (slope R = 0.7)" = "black")
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("All other children" = 16,
                                "Naughty in both years" = 17,
                                "Naughty in year 1, nice in year 2" = 1),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("Line of equality" = 0.4,
                                    "Regression line (slope R = 0.7)" = 1.1),
                         guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                               override.aes = list(shape = c(16, 17, 1, NA, NA),
                                                   linetype = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 1),
                                                   linewidth = c(NA, NA, NA, 0.4, 1.1)))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3.3, 3.3), ylim = c(-3.2, 3.2)) +
  labs(x = "Conduct score, year 1 (SD; lower = naughtier)",
       y = "Conduct score, year 2 (SD)") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.title = element_text(face = "plain"))
```
